title: BotWatchLinkRequest
description: bot.watch-link-request@1: the watch link an agent asks for on a person's own machine (plan L55). The desk is any desk the machine has — its own screen, the private desk, or the desk an agent task works on (desk-<name>) — and the link lives for minutes, not days.

desk.description: The desk the link shows. Absent: the machine's own screen.

control.description: true: the holders may use the mouse and keyboard too, at the level the owner set on the machine. Absent: they may only watch.

minutes.description: How long the link lives. Absent: 60 minutes.

label.description: Where the owner put the link ("the chat").
